Register a product

Source: R/publish-products.R
soil_product.Rd

A product is the family of results of one external model (e.g. a soil health index), attached to one canonical target level. Its scientific content lives in immutable versions (soil_product_version()); results are published in runs of a version (soil_run_open()).

Usage

soil_product(
  soil = soil_session(),
  product_code,
  name,
  target_level,
  description = NULL
)

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

product_code

Code of the product: lowercase letters, digits, _. API field product_code of POST /products; for soil_product_version(), API path parameter {product_code} of POST /products/{product_code}/versions.

name

Human name. API field name of POST /products.

target_level

The canonical level of its results: "feature", "profile", "component" or "horizon". API field target_level of POST /products.

description

Optional description. API field description of POST /products.

Value

The product: a list product_code, name, description, target_level.

Details

Registering the same definition again returns it unchanged. A product_code already registered with another name, description or target level is a soilhub_conflict_error (HTTP 409); the API offers no way to read the existing product, so keep using its code if it is yours, or choose another code.

Rights: soil:admin.

See also

Other writing: soil_product_version(), soil_publish_health(), soil_publish_source(), soil_publish_values(), soil_register_variable(), soil_run_open(), soil_source_validate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
soil_product(soil, "soil_health_fuzzy", "Soil health (fuzzy model)", "horizon")
} # }
